This implies a duality between classical determinism and quantum indeterminacy, wherein the latter emerges from complex rule-based evolution. The failure mode occurs when the automaton's resolution is insufficient to resolve quantum fluctuations, leading to loss of coherence. Thus, the core insight is that quantum measurement can be modeled as an information-theoretic process within a deterministic framework.
